newsitem.title: USA: Concord EFS files for 2 mln share offering.
newsitem.headline: Concord EFS files for 2 mln share offering.

text.p: Concord EFS Inc said Thursday that it filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission for a public offering of two million common shares.

Concord said in a release Thursday that the offering, co-managed by underwriters William Blair & Co, Montgomery Securities, Morgan Keegan & Co Inc and Adams, Harkness & Hill Inc, is expected in late October.
Concord said that all of the shares are being offered by the company, and that it has granted the underwriters an option for an aggregate of 300,000 additional shares to cover over-allotments.
